Subject: GCP Marketplace entitlement + procurement pathway — kickoff and action items

Hi all —

Thanks for making time. Per our pre-kick conversations, Acme is ready to go-live on GCP Marketplace (private listing + co-sell) and we need to align on the procurement & entitlement steps so onboarding is smooth and we don’t block their internal procurement. High-level asks: 

1) Confirm the Marketplace entitlement flow for a private listing (what GCP needs from Acme procurement vs. what Redwood needs to provide).
2) Document the PO/invoice path and expected lead times for a public vs private deal.
3) Kick off the SKU mapping and co-sell contact handoff (who at Google owns the co-sell).

Attachments: MAP-roles-and-handshake.pdf (internal mapping of roles + temporary SKU plan).

Action items I propose to start (please amend):
- GCP: share the private-listing entitlement checklist and DocuSign/contract links (action: GCP support).
- Acme: send PO template and billing contact (action: Alice Cho / procurement@acme.com).
- Redwood (Karthik/Marcus): map Redwood SKUs to Acme billing codes; confirm if they need marketplace invoice or vendor invoice.
- Redwood (Laura): supply co-sell lead contact for GCP.

Target: finalize entitlement checklist and PO path by COB next Wednesday (2026-11-03) so we can schedule final QA and go/no-go.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Private listing entitlement: we need the customer (Acme) to sign the GCP Marketplace Reseller Agreement and complete the e-commerce onboarding form. I will send the DocuSign link and checklist by EOD.
- Billing path: for private listings we can do either marketplace invoicing (Google invoices Acme and pays Redwood) or vendor-direct (Acme invoices Redwood). Marketplace invoicing typically adds ~7 business days to payment processing; vendor-direct depends on Redwood/Acme contract terms.
- Co-sell owner: assigning a regional channel rep is required for co-sell credits; I’m looping in the regional rep via separate thread.

Action items we’ll take:
- Share DocuSign + onboarding checklist (by 2026-10-29 17:00 PT).
- Provide SKU mapping template for your finance/ops to fill in.

We do have a pre-built PO template we occasionally share; if Acme prefers to use their own PO, that’s fine — the critical piece is the signed reseller agreement + e-commerce onboarding form.

Best,
GCP Marketplace Support

Alice — thanks for the quick turn. To address your questions and propose our preference: 

- Billing account: for private listings Acme can either use its GCP billing account (preferred) or use Google-managed billing. Using Acme's billing account makes invoicing simpler and keeps cost visibility local to your finance team. If Acme uses its own billing account we’ll ask you to provision a billing contact and a technical contact — the technical contact is used for initial quota/entitlement troubleshooting. Marcus (cc'd) is our recommended technical contact and will need the contact email added.

- Vendor-direct vs marketplace invoicing: we are fine with vendor-direct for the first 30 days. We will accept a PO (Acme template is fine) and provide an invoice directly if that expedites payment. After the trial period, we can transition to marketplace invoicing if Acme prefers.

Next steps (short):
- Alice: confirm billing account path and provide contact emails for billing + technical.
- GCP: send DocuSign + onboarding checklist (in progress).
- Marcus: I will coordinate with you offline to confirm the technical contact flow and permissions needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
